nativeQt.previewPolicy: No fabricated HTML/CSS replicas; native QML metadata describes the actual components.

evidence.status: Current shell-style implementation documented; visual review ongoing, no final verdict asserted.

narrative.overview: A compact, flat native controller following Omarchy shell panels, the complete live palette and shell monospace base-size. This supersedes the earlier large dark Material styling. The output remains a separate mpv media or standby surface.
keyCharacteristics: Square controls and small circular slider handles
Flexible queue between output and transport

rules.name: The Whole Theme Rule
rules.body: Keep playlist, controls, text, selection, and feedback bound to live palette roles.

dos: Do follow the full live palette and shell font size.
Do retain compact geometry and accessible keyboard semantics.
donts: Don't restore oversized rounded Material controls.
Don't freeze fallback colors or dynamic type sizes.
Don't invent browser tokens or replicas.
